[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]中文[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]中式庭院家具 & 荷花家具[/b]
这是一个中式庭院风格的家具模组，包含树木、水池、亭台、桥梁、座椅、照壁、花船等景观家具，适合用来布置庭院、园林、公园或农场角落。
同时包含荷花、睡莲、芦苇、芒草灯笼等荷花主题家具。
部分树木在晚上会发光，例如灯笼树、星星樱花树等。
本模组包含：[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][FF] 中式庭院家具[/b]：家具主体，需要 Furniture Framework。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][CP] 中式庭院家具-四季变化[/b]：为部分家具提供季节性贴图替换，需要 Content Patcher。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]荷花家具[/b]：包含大荷花、小荷花、睡莲、芦苇、芒草灯笼等，可通过目录购买。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]说明：[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]本模组中的家具贴图由 AI 绘制。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]座椅类家具都可以坐。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]部分树木在晚上会发光。[/color][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]English[/color][/size][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Chinese Courtyard Furniture & Lotus Furniture[/b]
A Chinese courtyard-style furniture mod, including trees, ponds, pavilions, bridges, seats, screen walls, flower boats, and other landscape furniture. It is suitable for decorating courtyards, gardens, parks, or farm corners.
It also includes lotus-themed furniture such as lotuses, water lilies, reeds, and miscanthus lanterns.
Some trees glow at night, such as the lantern tree and star cherry trees.
This mod includes:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][FF] Chinese Courtyard Furniture[/b]: The main furniture pack, requires Furniture Framework.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][CP] Chinese Courtyard Furniture - Seasonal[/b]: Provides seasonal texture replacements for some furniture, requires Content Patcher.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Lotus Furniture[/b]: Includes large lotuses, small lotuses, water lilies, reeds, and miscanthus lanterns. Can be purchased through a catalogue.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8][b]Notes:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The furniture textures in this mod are AI-generated.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]All seat furniture is sittable.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Some trees glow at night.[/color][/*]
[/list]
